main.description: Get a page of hydrated posts for a feed surface. Without feed, the AppView's default ordering for the scope is used; with feed, the named generator orders the posts.

feed.description: AT-URI of a social.coves.feed.generator record. Omit to use the default ordering for the scope.

scope.description: Which feed surface the request is for: all communities, the viewer's home feed, or one community

community.description: Community for scope=community (DID, handle, name@origin, or bare local name)

timeframe.description: Timeframe for feeds ranked by top score

errors.name: UnknownFeed
errors.description: The feed URI does not name a known feed generator.

errors.name: UnsupportedFeedScope
errors.description: The feed generator does not support the requested scope.

errors.name: InvalidCursor
errors.description: The cursor is malformed or expired; restart from the first page.

errors.name: CommunityNotFound
errors.description: The community for scope=community does not exist.

errors.name: AmbiguousCommunity
errors.description: The name@origin community identifier matches more than one community; address it by DID or handle instead.

errors.name: DiscoverUnavailable
errors.description: The all-communities feed is temporarily unavailable; retry later.

reqId.description: Request ID for this response, from the feed generator or assigned by the AppView. Clients send it back with interactions on items from this response.
